text.EN: I'm pretty shaken up right now.
My heart is pounding out of my chest.
text.TL: Napakabilis ng tibok ng puso ko sa kaba.

text.EN: That was way too close. Need a minute to breathe.
text.TL: Muntik na 'yon. Kailangan ko ng sandali para kumalma.

text.EN: Trying to keep my hands from shaking.
text.TL: Pinipigilan ko ang panginginig ng mga kamay ko.

text.EN: Terrified, if I'm being honest with you.
text.TL: Natatakot ako, kung sasabihin ko ang totoo.

text.EN: Felt like my heart was going to stop back there.
text.TL: Pakiramdam ko hihinto na ang puso ko kanina.

text.EN: Need to catch my breath and calm my nerves.
text.TL: Kailangang huminga nang malalim at pakalmahin ang sarili.

text.EN: Adrenaline is surging. Hard to think straight.
text.TL: Mataas pa ang adrenaline ko. Hirap mag-isip nang tuwid.

text.EN: Still feeling the panic creeping up on me.
text.TL: Nararamdaman ko pa rin ang takot na gumagapang sa akin.

text.EN: Give me a second to get my head together.
text.TL: Bigyan mo ako ng ilang sandali para makabawi ng katinuan.
